summary.text: Desiree Klaus is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 128 in the November 3, 2026, general election, running against Republican Tom Butler in a race with no incumbent.

Her campaign website describes her as a small-business owner and third-generation Baytown native, and lists investing in public schools and workforce training and supporting small businesses among her priorities.

sources.title: Meet Desirée - Desirée Klaus for State Representative, District 128
